faq: Does it have to be a Vision Plus?
Yes. For other brands, GreenBay can make you a cash offer at evaluate.greenbay.market.
For fridges, washing machines and TVs of 50 inches and up, a GreenBay technician comes to you. Smaller items can be dropped at a GreenBay shop. Our team calls you to arrange it.
What if it is very old or not working?
Send it in anyway. Every Vision Plus item we accept is worth at least KES 500 in credit. What we cannot resell is stripped for parts or recycled.
What if the check finds something different?
Our team talks it through with you first. No credit is issued until you agree.
How do I get and use my credit?
After the check, our team calls you with your Vision Plus credit code. Use it at Vision Plus within 90 days, across more than one purchase if you like, and pay any difference on your new item.
